claims.statement: The frontend is TingHire's recruiter/admin console: React 19 + TypeScript single-page app on react-admin (ra-core) and a vendored shadcn-admin-kit template, Vietnamese-only, talking to the FastAPI backend over REST and Socket.IO.

Product code lives in `frontend/src/components/atomic-crm/`. The dependency direction is strictly one-way: `atomic-crm → admin → ui`. `admin/` and `ui/` are vendored copy-paste dependencies and must never import from `atomic-crm/`.

The runtime that the app shell renders is statically compiled at build time by `src/components/atomic-crm/capabilities/static-recruitment-runtime.ts` from contributions under `capabilities/kernel/` and `capabilities/recruitment/`. `src/components/atomic-crm/root/CRM.tsx` renders the compiled runtime. Adding a new resource means writing a contribution, re-running the compiler, and rebuilding — there is no runtime registration.

One data provider: `src/components/atomic-crm/providers/rest/dataProvider.ts` maps react-admin verbs onto `/api/v1/{resource}`. There is no Supabase client and no FakeRest in production. Chat-specific ports live in `conversations/application/`; their REST and Socket.IO adapters live in `conversations/infrastructure/` and `providers/realtime/`. All HTTP adapters use `src/lib/apiClient.ts`.

Realtime: Socket.IO (WebSocket + polling fallback) at `/socket.io/`. Auth tokens live in `localStorage` under `RaStore.auth.*` (access + refresh); a 401 triggers one transparent refresh. The legacy `knowledge_sources` resource name targets the backend `/api/v1/knowledge/documents` route via the `RESOURCE_PATH` in the dataProvider.
